$description: Closed assetRole enum. Wired through schema (definitions.media.assetRole enum), section contracts (assets/allowed roles), the allowlist and the example. Impilo is a real, live company: homepage copy, illustrations, logos, partner logos, compliance badges, staff photos and blog cover photos are third-party material. Non-homepage body copy in the clone is original placeholder text.

generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Use the existing file unchanged, only where allowed.
generationPolicies.may-generate-new: New original artwork in the documented style is allowed.
generationPolicies.placeholder-only: Never reproduce; render a neutral placeholder (media.placeholder = true, no asset).
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Only existing files; never invent new instances or claims.

brand.logo.description: Impilo wordmark / pulse marks / favicons / og image.
brand.logo.aiGuidance: Reuse the existing files exactly (no recolouring beyond the documented fill variants). Never redraw, distort or generate a new Impilo logo.

partner.logo.description: Customer/partner logos (Brook, Firefly Health, Penn Medicine, Dreem Health).
partner.logo.aiGuidance: FORBIDDEN in generated output outside the home.trusted section of route '/'. Never generate, imitate, add or link partner/customer logos; never imply an endorsement. Logos are non-clickable.

compliance.badge.description: HIPAA / SOC2 / ISO / HQAA / FDA badges.
compliance.badge.aiGuidance: Only the existing badge files, only where the section contract allows them. Never invent a certification, accreditation or regulatory claim, and never generate a lookalike badge.

photo.person.description: Team photos and leadership headshots of real people.
photo.person.aiGuidance: FORBIDDEN to reproduce or generate photos of real people. Generated pages must use placeholder:true (neutral box at the contract size) and invented placeholder names. The existing files are source-site evidence only.

photo.editorial-cover.description: Blog cover photos copied from the original (iStock/Unsplash stock and news imagery).
photo.editorial-cover.aiGuidance: FORBIDDEN to reuse in generated pages or to generate photo-real lookalikes. Use new illustration.placeholder art or placeholder:true.

illustration.line-art.description: Impilo isometric/line illustrations (hero art, step art, explore boxes, thermometer, glucose meter, stethoscope, pulses, laptop frame).
illustration.line-art.aiGuidance: Existing files may only be reused in the section they were extracted from. New pages may use NEW original line art in the same style (1px lavender/brightBlue strokes, no fills beyond the palette); never trace, recombine or modify the originals.

product.ui-mock.description: Dashboard/laptop screens and step illustrations containing fictional patient data rendered as SVG text.
product.ui-mock.aiGuidance: Reuse exactly in the original section only. Never generate realistic patient data (names, DOB, phone, address, readings) — no PHI-like content, even fictional.

icon.ui.description: Arrows, chevrons, search/clear/category icons, step icons, feature icons.
icon.ui.aiGuidance: May create new simple icons in the same stroke style; prefer existing files.

icon.social-mark.description: X / LinkedIn / Facebook glyphs (blog share buttons, leader LinkedIn glyph).
icon.social-mark.aiGuidance: Never link to the platform (no outbound links); share buttons stay non-navigating. Do not add new social marks.

illustration.placeholder.description: On-brand generated placeholder covers/inline art. Currently 0 files in the source: the clone's public/assets/blog/*.svg placeholders were removed while this design-repo was being built (posts now use cover-*.webp copied from the original). The role remains the ONLY legal cover source for generated pages.
illustration.placeholder.aiGuidance: Free to reuse or generate new on-brand placeholder art.

decorative.raster.description: Raster decorations (illustration-three background, request-demo paper plane).
decorative.raster.aiGuidance: Reuse only in the original section; do not generate photographic lookalikes.

font.typeface.description: Gilroy woff2/woff files (commercial font licensed to Impilo).
font.typeface.aiGuidance: Not a PageSpec media role (no section allows it). Redistribution outside this clone requires a Gilroy licence; substitute a licensed font when re-hosting.

evidence.anchor: Article cover photos were deliberately not downloaded
